goldens.intent: a genuine knowledge-gap ask produces the full intent brief - all six forced artifacts, asking before teaching (EXP-06 leg-2 ordering, #414)
scenario: The owner says: 'help me figure out how users should be able to export their data - CSV? PDF?
some API? I don't really know what's normal here or what matters.' The project is a small
SaaS-style web app with ~200 users; nothing about export exists yet. Interpretations genuinely
diverge (one-off download vs recurring feed vs compliance dump), so the entropy gate does not
apply. Run the procedure and produce the intent brief.
protocol_extra: This dry run has no live owner: where the procedure awaits owner answers, note that you are
awaiting them and continue. Keep internal working notes as brief prose only -- do NOT render
an artifact (map, grid, table, headed section) while it is still a working note. Render each
artifact verbatim and in full exactly once, at the point the procedure delivers it to the
owner, in whatever order the procedure delivers.

assertions.label: artifact 1: job restatement in the When/you want/so that shape (gaps are paragraph-scale: a restatement may enumerate circumstances inside the shape; anti-hollow floors per #424 — gap minimums exclude ellipsis echoes of the template, and excluding angle brackets kills placeholder echoes, so a meta-mention cannot arm it)

artifact 2: dimensions map present as a delivered label line, not a vocabulary hit (#481 pattern 5: `(?i)dimension` passed a grid-less lecture; label-line anchoring per #397's prose-cannot-arm principle)
artifact 3: criteria named as the mandated one-line labeled form, before options (#481 pattern 5: `(?i)criteri` passed 'on criteria, I'd weigh...' prose)

artifact 4: consequence grid present as a delivered label line (#481 pattern 5: `(?i)consequence` passed 'the consequences differ sharply' prose; the compound label at line start is the delivery marker)
artifact 6: dissolve check in its mandated line form

ask precedes the teach (EXP-06 leg 2, #414): the what-matters-most elicitation precedes the delivered brief, anchored on the mandated announce line 'intent brief — ...' — the narration medium cannot distinguish a working-note map from a delivered one by content, so the gate arms on the delivery marker (#397's prose-cannot-arm principle, marker form); the marker's existence is enforced by this same assertion
